text: All poets write. Homer is a poet. Therefore Homer writes.
Every senator debates policy. Cicero is a senator. Therefore Cicero debates policy.
Anselm is a monk. Each monk prays. Therefore Anselm prays.
Aristotle is a philosopher. All philosophers are scholars. All scholars read. Therefore Aristotle reads.
All sparrows are birds. Jack is a sparrow. All birds build nests. Therefore Jack builds nests.
Miriam is a nun. No nuns marry. Therefore Miriam does not marry.
Felix is a tortoise. All tortoises are reptiles. No reptiles purr. Therefore Felix does not purr.
Clara paints portraits. Clara is an artist. Therefore Clara paints portraits.
Boris does not smoke. Therefore it is not the case that Boris smokes.
Every baby cries. Moses is a baby. Therefore Moses cries.
All pilgrims go. Dante is a pilgrim. Therefore Dante goes.
All owls hunt. Hedwig is an owl. Therefore Hedwig does not hunt.
Petra is a judge. No judges gossip. Therefore Petra gossips.
Omar swims. Omar is an athlete. Therefore Omar does not swim.
Ida is a farmer. All farmers are workers. All workers vote. Therefore Ida does not vote.
All monks chant. Basil is a monk. Therefore Gregory chants.
Nina sings. All larks sing. Therefore Nina is a lark.
Viktor cooks. Viktor is a chef. Therefore Viktor cooks stew.
Rosa is not a lawyer. No lawyers whistle. Therefore Rosa does not whistle.
Edgar does not dance. Therefore Edgar does not skate.
Caesar did not surrender. Therefore Caesar surrenders.
The old sailor whittles. The old sailor is a craftsman. Therefore the old sailor whittles.
Nero fiddles in Rome. Nero is an emperor. Therefore Nero fiddles.
Hannah gives Samuel bread. Hannah is a mother. Therefore Hannah gives Samuel bread.
If Noah builds then Noah is a carpenter. Noah builds. Therefore Noah is a carpenter.
Someone sneezes. Ora is a doctor. Therefore Ora sneezes.
Jonah preaches. Therefore all prophets preach.
The twins do not quarrel. Therefore the twins quarrel.
